meta.title: Loulou & Lou — A World of Songs and Stories
meta.description: The magical world of Loulou & Lou: music, fairytales, the Sprookjesfilm, audiobooks and the theatershow — all in one place.

hero.title: The World of Loulou & Lou
hero.subtitle: Songs to dance to, fairytales to fall asleep in, and a live band that makes it all come alive. One cosy corner of the internet for everything Loulou & Lou.

home.worldSubtitle: We've made music, films, stories and shows for years, scattered across the internet. This is where it all finally lives together.
home.listenSubtitle: Our albums and songs are streaming on your favourite platforms — tap through and press play.
home.charactersBody: Two best friends, one big imagination. Loulou & Lou lead every song, every fairytale and every stage show — and they can't wait to meet you.
home.bandTitle: Made with a real, live band
home.bandBody: Every show is played live by our band of wonderfully talented musicians — no backing tracks, just real instruments and real energy in the room.

about.title: A Dutch story, told to the whole world
about.intro: Loulou & Lou started in the Netherlands, made by a small team who believe children's music deserves the same craft and heart as any other kind. Today our songs, films and stories travel far beyond our own front door.
about.bandBody: On stage, every note is played live by our band of exceptionally talented musicians — the beating heart of every theatershow.
about.animatorBody: The Sprookjesfilm is animated entirely in-house, frame by frame, by our own animator.
about.contactBody: Booking a show, press enquiry, or just want to say hi? Get in touch.
